published_prior_art.cite: Huwang1995 establishes nonuniform coverage of an approximate binomial interval, and McGrathBurke2024 compares rare-binomial intervals; neither gives the causal four-cell profiled inversion.

repo_prior_art.cite: none; the Stat catalogue contains no PN/PS rare-event likelihood-transfer frontier.

published_prior_art.cite: TianWu2025 gives efficient regular PN/PS inference under monotonicity, not the triangular smoothness-rarity transfer region or its effective-count diameter rate.

TianWu2025 is fixed-law PN/PS inference and MikushevaSun2022 is uniformly valid jackknifed AR inference in linear many-weak-IV models; neither supplies an all-regime learned rare-PN likelihood transfer.
GleserHwang1987 supplies the finite-expected-diameter impossibility template, but not the bounded monotone PN least-favorable submodel or its effective-count rate.
HannartNaveau2018 and KirilioukNaveau2020 select climate events or projections to increase causal evidence, but do not give selection-honest learned-score likelihood-ratio inference.

soundness_flags.label: def:finite-lr and thm:finite-experiment
soundness_flags.one_line: Xi_n permits d(xi)=0 although the PN ratio is undefined there, and nd_n=O(1) alone does not specify a marked-Poisson limit; exclude or separately handle the zero-denominator boundary and state convergence to a defined limiting experiment (including its marks).

soundness_flags.label: lem:identification, def:ps-inversion, and every swapped PS conclusion
soundness_flags.one_line: The admitted class requires d_n>0 only for PN, while d_n^{PS}=E[(1-A)(1-Y)] may be zero, so the PS functional and swapped inversion need not be defined; add a symmetric positive factual-probability condition or restrict all PS claims.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:finite-experiment
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exact randomized coverage is claimed only for the explicitly defined finite empirical-support profiling experiment, not for arbitrary continuous Hölder laws.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Finite-experiment validity conditional on membership in the finite profiled experiment.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:gaussian-recovery
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Continuous-law Gaussian transfer and shrinking diameter are restricted to M_n^{LAN}.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Gaussian recovery only for P_n in M_n^{LAN}, under the displayed primitive rare-scale remainder condition.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair the finite experiment by separating its d=0 closure from parameterized PN nulls, and define a marked-Poisson experiment with explicit convergence assumptions such as nd_n→lambda and convergence of its mark law.
Add 0<d_n^{PS}≤bar d as a primitive symmetric rarity assumption, or remove PS from the headline, finite inversion, and all transfer claims.
Turn the all-regime question into a sharper frontier by proving a nuisance-learning converse outside M_n^{LAN}, thereby separating an intrinsic learning barrier from the effective-count lower bound.

recommended_next_step: Revise the PN zero-denominator/Poisson-limit specification and the missing PS positivity condition, then resubmit the repaired field-tier kernel.
